index.title: Workflows
index.description: How each request moves: who approves, in what order, and what happens after.
index.newHelp: Start with a blank Start → End and build from there.
index.name: Name
index.running: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing running} one {{formatted} running} other {{formatted} running}}

builder.desktopOnly: Editing workflows needs a wider screen. You can look around here.
builder.howTo: Click a step to add it, or drag it onto the canvas. Connect steps by dragging from an output to the next step.

approval.name: Approval
approval.help: Asks one or more people to approve. Rejection ends on the rejected path; they can also send it back for changes.

task.name: Task
task.help: A to-do with instructions, marked done when finished.

condition.name: Condition
condition.help: Checks the answers, the requester or earlier decisions, then follows Yes or No.

split.name: Parallel
split.help: Starts every connected branch at the same time. Bring them back with Join.

join.name: Join
join.help: Continues once every branch from the matching Parallel has finished.

notify.name: Notify
notify.help: Sends an in-app or email message. WhatsApp arrives with the WhatsApp integration.

delay.name: Wait
delay.help: Waits for a number of hours before continuing.

update_record.name: Update record
update_record.help: Writes the approved change to the person's record.

webhook.name: Webhook
webhook.help: Posts the request to an outside system, signed, with retries.

subworkflow.name: Sub-workflow
subworkflow.help: Runs another published workflow and continues on its outcome.

end.name: End
end.help: Ends the workflow with an outcome.

settings.label: Step name
settings.scoped: Only people whose scope covers the requester
settings.noEmployeeFields: The form has no person field.
settings.conditionHelp: Anything the rows can't express can be written as a rule.
settings.subject: Subject

simulator.title: Test run
simulator.help: Runs the canvas as it is now, with the answers and decisions below. Nothing is saved or sent.
simulator.noForm: This workflow isn't linked to a request type, so there are no answers to fill in.
simulator.failed: The test run couldn't start. Try again.

stopped.attention: Stopped: nobody could be assigned or a step failed. Check the assignees.
stopped.waiting: Still waiting on a step (for example a timer).

stuck.title: Needs attention
stuck.description: Workflows stopped on a step that failed every retry. Retry, skip the step, or cancel.
stuck.emptyHelp: Steps that fail all their retries show up here.
stuck.cancelHelp: Open approvals are withdrawn and the requester is told.
